apps.localizedDescription:
A native iPhone and iPad app data workspace with application names, read-only storage scans and file browsing, verified retained backups, and recoverable cache cleaning. English and Simplified Chinese.

Experimental preview intended for iOS/iPadOS 26 through 27 beta 3; newer systems are unverified. Both backends and the new app-management flows were tested on iPhone 11, iOS 26.0.1. The iOS 27 device evidence covers the older bad_query backend; worse_query and the new flows on iOS 27 remain unverified.

Re-signing must preserve a usable mapping of group.com.xnu.veilpath. After installing, run Settings > Advanced Tools > Diagnostics and Logs. AltStore Classic and SideStore installation and access still need channel-specific device validation. Not an AltStore PAL package.

Source and licensing notices accompany the IPA in GitHub Releases. The repository does not have one open-source license covering the complete work; see LICENSING.md.

versions.localizedDescription: Applications, Backups, and Settings provide a focused workspace.
